verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a card issuing product (Visa/Mastercard issuance, spend controls, authorization rules), so programmatic issuing disputes is a fair question for it. However, no evidence covers filing disputes, network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit, or dispute status webhooks. The authorization and spend-control features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution
